title: Chapter 105: Alliance'S Warning
content:
Chapter 105: Alliance'S Warning

Gou Yin thought about it carefully. He came to the house for the first time and said a few words to the Zerg. The Zerg had indeed been emphasizing that this city was their prize.

And he had always thought that the Zerg only wanted things in the city, and because the elders of the tribe had told him not to conflict with the Zerg, he wanted to leave the matter to be discussed later, so he casually replied "Okay" and said that he wanted to Report to the family.

However, the clan has been putting off discussing the matter, so they left it alone, which is regarded as acquiescence to this result.

Now people say that the two parties have agreed, and they seem to be right.

But Gou Yin is unwilling to admit the alliance's ownership of this place!

"What we agreed on was only the loot in the city! Not the city itself!"

"This was originally our clan's territory. It is only reasonable and reasonable to win the war and recover the lost land!"

Gou Yin argued hard.

"According to the agreed-upon profit distribution principles within the native race camp, whoever takes back the territory from the evil god camp belongs to him!"

"There is no such thing as this territory belongs to whomever it originally belonged to, and must be given to whomever it belongs to!"

"If the spoils of war are distributed according to this principle, then all the spheres of influence of the Tengu clan will now be returned to those ancient races that have disappeared for who knows how long!"

"Will you pay it back?!"

Meng asked loudly.

Gou Yin was so fiercely argued that he was speechless for a moment. In this world, power is the truth. Since his experience, he has never encountered a situation in foreign affairs where he could not use force to overwhelm others.

When facing the Evil God camp, just start the battle directly.

Compared with other races and territories in this area, the Tengu clan is absolutely powerful, and no one dares to bargain with the Tengu clan.

He really has not been trained in this level of reasoning with others. At this time, facing Meng, he felt that he was at a loss for words.

According to the usual behavior of the Tengu clan, what should I do if I don’t make sense? Of course he was going to threaten!

Gou Yin opened his mouth, but felt that there were some words that he couldn't say easily.

According to his understanding, the Zerg tribe behind this alliance is really not simple. If the Tengu tribe really comes into conflict with the Zerg tribe, no matter what the outcome is, the Evil God camp will take a big advantage.

Maybe the evil god camp will make a comeback while both sides are hurting.

Moreover, provoking a war within the local ethnic camp will have a very bad impact, and the tribe will be under great external pressure.

Various thoughts and concerns competed fiercely in Gou Yin's heart, causing him to lose control of his facial expression management, which he had not mastered yet. The expression on his face was very wonderful.

"What? Are you running out of words to explain?"

"You should withdraw your troops as soon as possible and let us build this city properly. With us here to share the pressure of the Evil God camp, you will be much more calm when facing the Evil God camp!"

"We are allies of the same camp. As long as we are friendly neighbors and jointly deal with the threats from the Evil God camp, maybe it won't be long before we can join forces to regain a large number of territories occupied by the Evil God camp!"

"Who cares about such a tiny place then?"

"Do you think this is true?"

Seeing Gou Yin's performance, Meng's tone softened, and he analyzed the benefits of giving up the alliance's important city to Gou Yin, and also thought about the future.

"This matter has gone beyond the scope of my rights. I have to go back and report it!"

Gou Yin felt that talking to Meng was indeed very stressful. His mind was a little confused now and he just wanted to leave here as soon as possible.

As for the problems raised by the alliance, let the big guys in the clan deal with them. He didn't want to deal with them anymore.

"Okay! We'll be waiting here!"

"If you don't give a clear reply today, our Zerg army will come tomorrow and forcibly expel the non-alliance troops outside the Alliance City!"

"If this triggers a war, the responsibility lies entirely with you!"

Meng solemnly issued a warning to Gou Yin who wanted to leave as soon as possible.

If Meng didn't say this, it would definitely be very difficult to wait for the Tengu clan's reply.

The Tengu clan uses the word "drag" to its fullest potential.

Gou Yin's face was ugly. In the past, it was the Tengu clan that threatened others. When had he ever been threatened by others?

But the alliance seemed confident and fearless, so he had to pay attention to Meng's warning.

I'm afraid that the big guys in the clan still don't understand the situation and are perfunctory, which will lead to unpredictable consequences.

From the fact that the alliance neatly killed two thousand elite cavalry of the Tengu clan, it can be seen that the fierce warning is not a joke. The alliance has the ability and courage to fight against the Tengu clan.

Gou Yin took the fierce warning to heart, but refused to admit defeat, turned around and left quickly without saying a word.

Looking at Gou Yin and the Tengu cavalry leaving, he burst into laughter: "Hahaha! Do you see that? As long as you have the courage, and the alliance has the support of the Zerg, no one has to be afraid!"

The fierce representative of the alliance was so proud, and the lords present were also very excited. Once upon a time, they had to grovel in front of the Tengu clan in order to beg the Tengu clan to let them live.

Those territories and lords targeted by the Tengu clan have long since disappeared into the dust of history. It is a blessing of fate that they can survive to this day.

"If the Tengu tribe doesn't reply and doesn't withdraw its troops, will we really fight?"

A lord asked Meng in a low voice.

"Fight! Of course we have to fight!"

"Dignity comes from fighting! If you don't fight a few times, who will give you face?!"

Meng deliberately did not lower his voice, and Gou Yin could hear the loud speaker-like voice from afar.

"Okay! If we really want to fight, all the troops in my territory must go on the field!"

The lord who asked the question unconsciously raised his voice.

"No problem! Let's fight together! Everyone come to cheer!"

"Come on, everyone, put out the wine and meat!"

"We can't wait here stupidly. It's a rare opportunity for everyone to camp together in the wild. Let's continue to eat, drink and chat!"

"If we wait for good news today, everything will be fine. If we don't wait for good news, everyone will eat and drink this meal and go to the battlefield together tomorrow!"

Meng is like a head of the family, arranging things properly, without Wu Qing worrying about it.

"Okay! Go to the battlefield together! Fight for our dignity!"

"Haha, we can force the Tengu tribe to reply to us within a time limit. I feel that today's weather is particularly sunny! The air is also particularly sweet!"

"I'm in a good mood today! Everyone must drink a few more glasses!"

"..."

Meng led everyone to drink and eat meat to release the suppressed emotions.

Wu Qing, like an ordinary lord, drank and chatted with Hu Wei, Shi Gan, and several other lords who liked quietness.

Because of the fierceness, it is now popular in the alliance to drink and eat meat together.

Seeing the performance of the lords of the alliance, Wu Qing knew that what he did today had achieved the expected effect.
